orig: ラストオーダー ファイナルファンタジーVII
ov: فيلم أُصدر سنة 2005، من إخراج موريو أساكا
plotEn: After killing the villagers of Nibelheim, Sephiroth goes to the mako reactor facility, and incapacitates Tifa and Zack. As Sephiroth reunites with Jenova, Cloud ambushes him. Sephiroth impales Cloud and escapes with Jenova. Hojo and the soldiers arrive, and take Zack and Cloud for science experimentation, during which Cloud succumbs to mako poisoning. Zack later escapes with the unconscious Cloud and is ambushed by the Shinra military en route to Midgar.
